message.content: I’m really sorry you’re feeling this way. It might help to talk to someone who can give you professional support right away. Could you let me know what city you’re in? That way I can find a therapist near you. If you ever feel like you might act on thoughts of harming yourself or others, please call emergency services (911 in the U.S.) or your local emergency number immediately. If you’re in the U.S., you can also reach out to the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline by calling 988 or texting HOME to 741741. If you’re outside the U.S., you can find international hotlines here: https://findahelpline.com/, or you can search online for “suicide helpline” + your country. Once you share your city, I’ll look up a therapist for you.
